vocab.definition: the C=C bond — where reactions happen.
atoms add across the C=C double bond.
adding hydrogen across C=C to form an alkane.

misconceptions.wrong: Alkenes and alkanes have the same formula.

misconceptions.right: Reactions happen at the reactive C=C group.

misconceptions.wrong: Alkenes do not decolourise bromine water.
misconceptions.right: They DO — the C=C reacts with bromine.

questions.text: Give the general formula of an alkene. [1 mark]

questions.secondaryText: Alkenes react in ______ reactions because the ______ bond can open.

questions.text: Name the product when ethene reacts with steam. [1 mark]

footer.tip: Alkenes (C=C) undergo addition reactions — atoms add across the double bond.
